name: Special Relationship to Aruba

requirements.blocker_text: Requires having been married to an Aruban/Dutch national spouse for more than 5 years before the marriage ended, with no children from the marriage.

Requires having been married for more than 5 years and having had, adopted, or recognised a child with Dutch nationality during the marriage, with the child residing at the same address as the applicant.

requirement_groups.name: Child of a Dutch national born in Aruba

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the child of a Dutch national born in Aruba, without personally possessing Dutch nationality.

requirement_groups.name: Unmarried parent with custody of an Aruban national child

requirements.blocker_text: Requires legal custody of a child holding Aruban/Dutch nationality; if the child does not reside with the applicant, structural financial support of the child through alimony payments is required instead.

evidence_required.document: Child's birth/nationality documentation and proof of shared address or alimony payments (child-related grounds)

sources.title: DIMAS, Government of Aruba -- Special Relationship to Aruba: four grounds (former spouse 5yr+ no children; former spouse 5yr+ with a Dutch-national child; child of a Dutch national born in Aruba; unmarried parent with custody of, or alimony support for, an Aruban national child), 3-month departure rule for shorter marriages without children

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Aruba's initial build. This is a residual, contingency-driven residence ground -- typically for a former spouse of an Aruban/Dutch national whose marriage has ended, or a parent/child with an otherwise-qualifying Dutch/Aruban family tie who does not fit the standard partner or family-reunification routes. The source is explicit that a spouse divorced after a SHORTER marriage (under 5 years) with no children must depart within 3 months -- i.e. this route is precisely the exception carved out for the 5-year-plus case, not a general post-divorce safety net; flagged prominently since it materially changes the outcome for anyone below that threshold. Four OR-groups folded into one file since all four lead to the same 'special relationship' residence outcome on the same application form. No fee information was found on the source page.
